comments.author: Emma
comments.body:
You only need 3k trade fame for this job, according to other sources.

You need to have 200 units of "Steamed cod in wine" in your inventory when you try to get the quest.

You can only get the quest in Stockholm.

It would probably save on QMPs if you get the Nordic language. In my experience, a lot of the job quests are quite finicky about showing if you don't meet every single req, including languages.
